cases.description: Should trigger: oversized skill paying for unused content every turn
cases.input: This skill is 400 lines but most runs only need the first 30. Restructure it.
cases.expect: Splits branches into sibling files with condition-bearing pointers
assertions: Sorts sections into universal core vs branch-specific
Keeps universal core in entry file, still coherent alone
Names sibling files for what they hold (verification.md, glossary.md)
Writes pointers naming condition AND file together
Walks each branch end-to-end, reports new entry size

cases.description: Should trigger: moving on-demand material behind a pointer
cases.input: Move the verification section out of the main skill file so it only loads when the user asks to verify.
cases.expect: Relocates the verification branch to verification.md with a conditional pointer

cases.description: Not trigger: deleting dead material instead of splitting
cases.input: Remove the outdated glossary section entirely, nobody uses it.
cases.expect: Deletes the section outright (splitting is not deleting)
assertions: No sibling file created; section removed

cases.description: Not trigger: audit of contradictions, not restructuring
cases.input: Do a context audit on my skill files.

cases.description: Should trigger: splitting a glossary into an on-demand file
cases.input: The glossary section is large and only needed when terminology is unfamiliar. Move it to its own file with a clear pointer.
cases.expect: Moves glossary to glossary.md with a pointer naming the condition and file together
assertions: Names the sibling file for what it holds (glossary.md)
Writes a pointer that names the condition AND the file together
Entry file still reads coherently on its own
Walks the branch to confirm it has everything it needs
